en.description: Turn your school, class, year, motto, and shared memories into original lyrics and a song the whole class can sing together. This school song maker writes a class song, graduation song, freshman welcome song, school anthem, teachers' day song, school anniversary song, or sports day song with a chorus that is easy to learn, shapes the words with you line by line, and produces the finished song with a student choir, children's choir, or solo voice for assemblies, opening and graduation ceremonies, class meetings, and school performances.
en.summary: Turn your school, class, motto, and memories into original lyrics and a sing-along class song, graduation song, or welcome song.
en.title: School Song Maker: Class Song, Graduation Song & Welcome Song
